This test ensures that if an autoscroll starts from within a scrollable div in a non-scrollable iframe, it does not propagate to its document body.

On success, you will see a series of "PASS" messages, followed by "TEST COMPLETE".

PASS Document didn't scroll.
PASS successfullyParsed is true

TEST COMPLETE
